points.quote: Each document is a Yjs CRDT (`Y.Doc`). A workspace has a root doc, whose `meta` map lists the pages, plus one Y.Doc per page.
Storage holds Yjs binary updates and snapshots, not JSON.
Awareness (cursors and presence) uses its own channel and isn't persisted.
Browser: IndexedDB (`impls/idb`), one database per workspace named `workspace:<id>`. ... Desktop and mobile: a per-workspace SQLite file written by native Rust code (`impls/sqlite`
Offline edits stay in local storage and are pushed on reconnect. ... Cloud workspaces sync with the AFFiNE server through socket.io
